about_the_game:
Floyds cafe is a cafe management game where you manage a cafe, play as Floyd, an orange cat and make the Cafe of your dreams. Make a variety of drinks each with there own complex but relaxing interactions. You can even make Moka pot coffee out of Beanino coffee beans! (Beanino is a random name I came up for the coffee bean type in my game don't ask why I named it that, it sounds Italian and that's the main thing)

If you want a peaceful relaxing game with out any stressful mechanics attached Floyd's cafe is just for you! You can just chill out and make some tea or whatever the customers want. Making any drink is soothing and extremely satisfying even after doing it once or a thousand times! Use your profits to buy different machines to make more drinks or decorate your cafe to your hearts desires. Knock you self out at Floyd's Cafe! (For legal reasons please do not literally knock yourself out, thank you!)

This game is still very early in its development phase hence why there is no cafe customization in the screenshots. However I am busy at work and the demo will come out very soon!

short_description: Build your dream cafe and make an assortment of drinks at Floyd's Cafe! Floyd's Cafe is primarily about well Floyd's cafe... Make anything from black tea to Moka pot coffee or even just a lame old coffee maker. Decorate the Cafe with Vines, shelfs, and even cactuses.
